Metadata.Title: RHSA-2026:98512: glibc security, bug fix, and enhancement update (Moderate)
Metadata.Description:
The glibc packages provide the standard C libraries (libc), POSIX thread libraries (libpthread), standard math libraries (libm), and the name service cache daemon (nscd) used by multiple programs on the system. Without these libraries, the Linux system cannot function correctly.

Security Fix(es):

* glibc: nscd stack overflow leads to degraded DNS resolution (CVE-2026-89092)

* glibc: glibc: Privilege escalation and arbitrary code execution via TOCTOU race condition in dynamic loader (CVE-2026-86805)

* glibc: glibc: Local attacker can cause denial of service and information disclosure via stack-based buffer overflow. (CVE-2026-95818)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* glibc: Fix race condition in tst-bz21269 [rhel-9.9.z] (JIRA:RHEL-283707)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
